title: OpenStax IA 2e Try It 9.119: complete the square for x^2 + 2x − 3
stem_student: Rewrite f(x) = x^2 + 2x − 3 in the form f(x) = (x − h)^2 + k by completing the square.
stem_teacher: Sign-of-b variation after Example 9.60 (x^2 + 6x + 5). OpenStax Try It 9.119 also asks to graph by transformations; this item is the rewrite only so A2.5/A2.6 are not retaught.
answer_verification: Author-computed completing-the-square rewrite of the licensed stem: half of 2 is 1; 1^2 = 1; add and subtract 1; (x + 1)^2 − 3 − 1 = (x + 1)^2 − 4. OpenStax student page lists the Try It without an inline solution; Try It answers live in the book Answer Key and were not copied into this record.
